title: A Safety, Tolerability, and Efficacy Study of VX-880 in Participants With Type 1 Diabetes
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the safety, tolerability and efficacy of VX-880 infusion in participants with Type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1D) and impaired awareness of hypoglycemia (IAH) and severe hypoglycemia.
inclusion_criteria:
Key inclusion criteria: 

 Clinical history of T1D with > 5 years of duration 

 At least two episodes of documented severe hypoglycemia in the 12 months prior to enrollment 

 Stable diabetic treatment 

 Consistent use of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) for at least 3 months before Screening and willingness to use CGM for the duration of the study 

 Key
exclusion_criteria:
: 

 Prior islet cell transplant, organ transplant, or cell therapy 

 Other protocol defined Inclusion/
